BluePearl Pet Hospital emergency vet and specialty animal hospital – serving Greater Boston.
We are centrally located in Charlestown, and serve the entire greater Boston area, including the communities of Somerville, East Boston, Cambridge, Medford, Malden, Winchester and Everett.
Our reviews.
Our services.
When you have a pet emergency, seconds count. We want you to know, we’re ready, 24/7 days a week, 365 days a year—even holidays. If your pet has a condition that requires a specialist’s expertise, we’re ready for that too. Our experienced veterinarians, vet technicians and support staff work closely together to provide the comprehensive, compassionate care your pet needs and deserves.
Emergency
In an emergency, call ahead to your BluePearl vet and let us know you’re coming. No appointment is necessary for our emergency vet.

Specialty care
Our veterinary specialists work directly with your primary care vet to understand your pet’s condition and develop the appropriate treatment plan. Visits to our specialists are usually by referral from your primary care vet and by appointment.

Emergency veterinary care at BluePearl Charlestown, Boston FAQ.
What is considered a veterinary emergency?
Signs like difficulty breathing, collapse, serious injuries, prolonged vomiting or diarrhea, seizures, or suspected poisoning should be treated immediately. If you’re unsure whether it’s an emergency, please come in and we can assess your pet’s condition.
Is BluePearl Pet Hospital Charlestown open 24/7 for emergencies?
Yes, our Charlestown location is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including weekends and holidays, for emergency and critical care services.
Should I call before coming in?
If possible, yes. Calling ahead allows our team to prepare for your arrival and begin triage as soon as possible. However, it is not necessary to call ahead in an emergency situation; we are open 24/7 for emergencies.
What should I bring to an emergency vet visit?
Bring your pet’s medical history, current medications, and any details about the emergency if handy. We will also contact your primary care vet for records. If your pet has eaten something toxic, bring the packaging if available.
How much will emergency care cost?
Emergency care costs vary depending on the situation. Our team will provide a treatment plan and estimate before proceeding. BluePearl Charlestown accepts major credit cards and CareCredit.
Does BluePearl accept pet insurance?
Yes, we accept pet insurance plans, including Trupanion direct, rather than waiting to get reimbursed, we can pay BluePearl Charlestown right at checkout in seconds. While we don’t process other insurance company claims directly, we’re happy to provide you with detailed invoices and medical records to support your claim submission.
Can I stay with my pet during the exam or treatment?
For your pet’s safety and due to medical protocols, you may be asked to wait in a designated area. Rest assured, we’ll keep you updated and involved throughout your pet’s care.
What specialties are available at this location?
In addition to emergency care, BluePearl Charlestown may offer specialties such as surgery, internal medicine, and critical care. Check our website or call for up-to-date specialty services.

About BluePearl Pet Hospital Charlestown.
Our specialty and emergency animal hospital in Charlestown makes its home in Boston’s oldest neighborhood, across the Charles River from downtown. The clinic, just west of Interstate 93 and convenient to the Orange Line, is centrally located for pet emergencies in the greater Boston area. History buffs will recognize the site as part of the old H.P. Hood dairy, but it’s now a state-of-the-art veterinary clinic.
A 64-slice CT scanner allows our highly skilled BluePearl vets to better inform humans about a pet’s medical condition. Our diagnostic capabilities also include high-tech ultrasound and a wide array of minimally invasive equipment.
BluePearl opened our nearly 10,000-square-foot pet hospital in 2017, assembling a friendly and compassionate staff from around the country. Along with emergency care, we offer a number of advanced specialties and can also draw from the expertise of our sister hospital in
Waltham
.
